svg.title: How faces_reciprocal sets the inbound heading of a bay and a charger
svg.desc: Animated: bay 7 and chargers 10 and 14 of the Pecos YAML; GetInboundHeading adds 180 when faces_reciprocal is true and does not wrap; the bay pose, its outbound pose, the retrieval heading cached on parking nodes, the charging poses, and the unwrapped comparison that PR #1018 fixed.
svg.metadata: ["Three YAML entries that all list headings [90]. Bay 7 and charger 14 add faces_reciprocal: true; charger 10 has faces_reciprocal: false. The heading list alone says only which axis the node allows (90 and its reciprocal -90); faces_reciprocal picks the direction that counts.", "GetInboundHeading (layout.cpp L34) returns headings[0] + faces_reciprocal x 180: 90 + 180 = 270 for bay 7. It does not wrap. GetBayInboundHeading wraps it: Wrap(270) = -90, the only form a GaragePose can hold (int16 in [-179, 180]).", "The bay pose (7, -90). Heading -90 faces east: AGV-1's body +x, its long and driving axis, points out of the bay through the garage-side door towards W31. With faces_reciprocal false it would face west, towards the patron side (layout.hpp words it as '+y axis', meaning the helper frame's y, which is the AGV's +x).", "GetBayOutboundPose (pose_graph.cpp L215) builds the same primary pose and returns its LEFT neighbour: (31, -90), 4.902 m east, a LOCOMOTE along body +x. The header promises it is always LEFT; nothing in the snapshots calls it.", "The retrieval heading. bay_prioritization_ is [21, 7] (both values 0, ties to the higher id), so StorePreferredPayloadHeadingsForRetrieval takes back() = bay 7, its inbound heading -90 and the reverse 90. It caches 90 on every Parking node that allows 90 and can reach (7, 90): all ten, P5 and P15 among them.", "Chargers. C10: faces_reciprocal false, 90 + 0 = 90, AGV-1 charges facing west. C14 (and C16): true, 90 + 180 = 270, stored as pose (14, -90), AGV-2 charges facing east. Both are reached by a 0.61 m strafe: (9, 90) FORWARD -> (10, 90) and (15, -90) FORWARD -> (14, -90).", "The unwrapped comparison, fixed in PR #1018. PlanAgvChargeJob asked whether the AGV was already charging with agv.pose.heading == GetInboundHeading(curr_node): 90 == 90 for AGV-1 on C10, but -90 == 270 for AGV-2 on C14, so AGV-2 was sent to another free charger. ExpandAgvChargeJob (job_expansion.cpp L624) now compares agv.pose == MakeInboundPose(curr_node), which wraps: (14, -90) == (14, -90)."]

g.text: transition pose in tray assignment also used the unwrapped value; Pecos has no VECS node. Map labels: P17, W22, B21, C14 = node_id 17, 22, 21, 14 (P parking, W waypoint, B bay, C AGV charger); T17 = tray_id 17; AGV-1 = agv_id 1; X@90 = GaragePose {node_id: X, heading: 90}, heading in degrees [-179, 180], 90 = facing -x.
